::: {#exr-cyclone-score-fn}
#### Score function of the dataset

Derive the [score function](intro-MLEs.qmd#def-score) for the dataset.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-cyclone-score-fn}

The score function is the first derivative of the log-likelihood
from @exr-sample-llik:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\ell'(\lambda; \vx)
&\eqdef \deriv{\lambda}\paren{\paren{\sum_{i = 1}^n x_i}\logf{\lambda} - n\lambda - \sum_{i = 1}^n \logf{x_i!}}
&& \text{(definition of the score)}\\
&= \paren{\sum_{i = 1}^n x_i}\deriv{\lambda}\logf{\lambda} - n\deriv{\lambda}\lambda - \deriv{\lambda}\sum_{i = 1}^n \logf{x_i!}
&& \text{(linearity of differentiation)}\\
&= \paren{\sum_{i = 1}^n x_i}\frac{1}{\lambda} - n - 0
&& \text{(derivatives of $\log \lambda$, $\lambda$, and a constant)}\\
&= \frac{n \bar x}{\lambda} - n
&& \text{($\textstyle\sum_{i=1}^n x_i = n \bar x$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

For the cyclone data, $n = `r n`$ and $n \bar x = `r sumx`$,
so $\ell'(\lambda; \vx) = `r sumx`/\lambda - `r n`$.

:::
